changelog:
- Fullscreen Webpage Auto-Expansion: When the command bar collapses on scroll, the webpage dynamically expands to fill 100% of the display for both top and bottom command bar positions.
- Seamless Viewport Transition: Webpage bounds restore smoothly when the command bar reappears, ensuring no content is obstructed or cropped.
- Complete v2.0.4 fixes: Video screen-on lock, dual-screen hydration, unblocked start page buttons, edge-to-edge docked styling, and Bing app banner defusal.
